<% if projekt_feature?(@projekt_phase.projekt, "general.vc_map_enabled") %>
  <% provide :vc_maps do %>
    <script id="vcmap-core" type="module" src="/vcmap/vcmap-core.js"></script>
  <% end %>
<% end %>

<% if @landing_page.present? %>
  <%= render "pages/brand_color_styles", page: @landing_page %>
<% end %>

<%= render UserResources::FormComponent.new(
  @proposal,
  url: proposals_path,
  title: t("new.start_new", scope: "proposals")
) %>

observation.command: cd /workspace && git show HEAD:app/views/custom/proposals/new.html.erb | head -15; echo "=== was this file modified? ==="; git status --short app/views/custom/proposals/new.html.erb; echo "(empty = unmodified)"
